notes.title: Song of Farca full version is now available
notes.notes:
Check it out: Song of Farca full version is now available on Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store worldwide 🎉

Cheers for that!

Step into the shoes of a private detective Isabella Song: hack into devices, look for clues, analyze data, and interrogate the suspects.  Investigate the most complex cases in Farca taken over by gangs and corporations! Still, remember that even a criminal can turn out to be a victim. 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435670/Song_of_Farca/
 
Besides, there’s a special release discount for the whole week! Play and join the Discord-server of Song of Farca: discord.gg/r5qDKF8JmK ❤️

We’re looking forward to your feedback, and have a good game!
